name: Senhata (Japan)
description: A red field charged at the centre with the Senhata town emblem in white: a ring beneath a stylised bird with a five-pointed star.
history: Flag of the former town of Senhata in Akita Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-11-01. Flag and emblem were adopted in 1966.

features.role: Senhata town emblem — a ring beneath a stylised bird with a five-pointed star
